items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Frank' in the context of Jelly Roll Morton's learning process ('Because Frank would get it') and describes him as 'a handsome boy' and 'the little holler', but does not describe a direct personal interaction or professional relationship with Frank.

ctx.x: They were all right. That's what made me stop taking this. Yeah, we need you. And you were really learning, Kelly, from Joneses. Because Frank would get it.
And you were really learning piano from Jelly. Because Frank would get it.
Jelly and Tom Turpin. Because Frank. He was a handsome boy. Good looking. He was the little holler.
